title: My favourite food
instructions: Carlos sevdiği ve sevmediği yiyecekleri anlatıyor. "but" ve "don't" kelimelerine dikkat et.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: Hi, I'm Carlos. I'm from Spain, but I live in London now.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: My favourite food is pizza. I eat pizza every Friday.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I like fish, but I don't like meat.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: For breakfast, I usually have bread and cheese.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: I drink orange juice in the morning.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: My mother is a very good cook.

script.speaker: carlos
script.text: On Sundays, we eat lunch together at home.
